units.summary: Choose leading/trailing probes from signed X velocity and reverse facing when terrain masks require it.

units.name: FindPlayerSupportingObject
units.summary: Search active supports for horizontal/vertical overlap and attach the player while copying the support's X/Y fractional fields.

units.name: JumpToObjectTypeHandler
units.summary: Resolve the object's type to a split low/high pointer and jump through scratch.

units.name: SelectEligibleObjectAudioCue
units.summary: Choose $19 or $1A based on type-one object flags, avoiding a duplicate request for the active cue.

units.name: NextPresentationListPair
units.summary: Advance the paired presentation list cursor, inspect it in PRG pair four, and run each nonzero item through the bank-restoring effect wrapper.

units.name: SetPresentationAnchorPalette
units.summary: At the exact animation anchor, install target/working accent colors and clear the fade step.

units.name: DrawPresentationValueRows
units.summary: Queue the fixed value and three paired RAM values at successive PPU row positions.

units.name: RunAfterRenderGameplayPass
units.summary: Select PRG pair two for scene interactions, restore PRG pair six, then render/update and save prior player input/coordinates.

units.name: CommitPendingSceneUploads
units.summary: Promote the graphics-pending byte to the shared upload commit flag, then clear the local request.

units.name: TransferRecordedPlayerState
units.summary: During scene mode two, write the packed player-state run and read the seven buffered PPU sample pairs.

units.name: TransferPendingAttributeByte
units.summary: Read the prepared attribute byte, or write its replacement when the high address flag marks it dirty.

units.name: CheckPlayerObjectOverlap
units.summary: Build the player rectangle, scan eligible active object slots and choose a special contact state or common failure handling.

units.name: HandleSceneExitTile
units.summary: Find tile $22 among three samples, replace its metatile, set the current scene-completion bit and freeze all object updates.

units.name: ConsumePendingSceneAction
units.summary: Clear the pending scene selector and call the banked scene action with its zero-based doubled index.

units.name: CheckPlayerHorizontalOverflow
units.summary: Nonzero player horizontal high byte requests transition and clears the action countdown.

units.name: EnterPlayerFailureState
units.summary: Mark the player state $FF, select script $0B and clear transient type-zero objects.

units.name: DispatchNewSecondaryButtonPress
units.summary: Require a new B press and nonzero selector, then resolve and call the secondary-action pointer.

units.name: SpawnSecondaryActionObject
units.summary: Require selector at least two and no active type-zero object, stage equal horizontal parameters and invoke the facing-dependent spawn helper.

units.name: ReleasePlayerTransitionLock
units.summary: After the player crosses the staged tile boundary, realign terrain, release object freeze bits and clear the player transition flag.

units.name: CollectPlayerContactTiles
units.summary: Derive sample points, read center/top/bottom tiles and retain side RAM pointers plus matching PPU addresses for later mutations.

units.name: DispatchPlayerTerrainAction
units.summary: Resolve the current player action through split address tables and jump indirectly; action meanings are known only for classified handlers.

units.name: AlignPlayerVerticalToTerrain
units.summary: Accept boundary contact at permitted subpixel positions, align Y to an eight-pixel row and reset motion/tile animation state.

units.name: CollectPlayerSideTiles
units.summary: Read three vertical sample points on each side of the player; obstructing tile IDs restore the prior horizontal coordinate.

units.name: RestorePlayerXOnTerrainId
units.summary: Compare A with the appropriate side samples for the movement direction. Matching IDs restore the previous player X.

units.name: ComputePlayerTerrainProbeCoordinates
units.summary: Derive five Y samples and three X samples around the player's current coordinates.

units.name: ReadSceneTileAtPixel
units.summary: A is Y pixels and scratch $18 is X pixels. Resolve a RAM map cell, return its low six bits, or return tile $0E outside the horizontal domain.

units.name: InitializeOrdinaryPlayerAndHooks
units.summary: Install ordinary before/after-render hooks, reset allocation/movement fields, allocate the player and place it relative to the camera.

units.name: SetNmiTailHook
units.summary: Store A/X as the NMI tail callback CPU address.

units.name: SetBeforeRenderHook
units.summary: Store A/X as the before-render callback CPU address.

units.name: SetAfterRenderHook
units.summary: Store A/X as the after-render callback CPU address.

units.name: InitializeOverlaySpritesWrapper
units.summary: Enter PRG pair four, initialize the overlay sprite sequence and restore the gameplay bank.

units.name: MoveOverlayRightBoundaryWrapper
units.summary: Enter PRG pair four, move the right boundary and restore the gameplay bank.

units.name: MoveOverlayLeftBoundaryWrapper
units.summary: Enter PRG pair four, move the left boundary and restore the gameplay bank.

units.name: FinishOverlaySpritesWrapper
units.summary: Enter PRG pair four, finalize sprites/text and restore the gameplay bank.

units.name: InitializeOverlayPaletteWrapper
units.summary: Enter PRG pair four, initialize its palette effect and restore the gameplay bank.

units.name: WaitOverlayFramesWrapper
units.summary: Wait A presentation frames in fixed code, then restore PRG pair four.

units.name: TestInventoryFlagWrapper
units.summary: Enter PRG pair four, test A's packed flag selector and restore the gameplay bank while retaining the result.

units.name: DrawSpriteRectangleCell
units.summary: Read one tile; zero advances grid position without emitting an OAM record.

units.name: ApplySpriteRectangleAttributes
units.summary: Read the trailing attribute byte and assign its low two bits to emitted OAM records in reverse order.

units.name: PasswordStringPairs
units.summary: 82 highbit-terminated password strings partition exact interval; independently read pointers, terminators and all41equal-length/permutation pairs. Copy consumers anchored B6C6/B718; original shuffle/natural solution not asserted.

units.name: ScrambledPasswordPointers
units.summary: 41 little-endian pointers; two independently anchored consumer bases B6C6/B718 and following called routine B76A fix bounds. All82 target records satisfy paired buffer contract.

units.name: ExpectedPasswordPointers
units.summary: 41 little-endian pointers; two independently anchored consumer bases B6C6/B718 and following called routine B76A fix bounds. All82 target records satisfy paired buffer contract.

units.name: CameraDirectionByDistance
units.summary: BCBD..BD03 clamps Y to 0..31; reads BD05/BD25/BD45. LDY #1F guarantees BNE, no fallthrough. Exact saved camera-decode.json independently reviewed.

units.name: CameraIntegerSpeedByDistance
units.summary: BCBD..BD03 clamps Y to 0..31; reads BD05/BD25/BD45. LDY #1F guarantees BNE, no fallthrough. Exact saved camera-decode.json independently reviewed.

units.name: CameraFractionalSpeedByDistance
units.summary: BCBD..BD03 clamps Y to 0..31; reads BD05/BD25/BD45. LDY #1F guarantees BNE, no fallthrough. Exact saved camera-decode.json independently reviewed.

units.name: TerrainPolicyAndSlopeData
units.summary: F7CC resets02DE,X; F76B/F72D only indirect-read, C15B preservesX. Slope increment cannot wrap and BNE returns F814. Repeated policy/slope values end at controller routine F8BA. terrain/helper decodes independently reviewed.

units.name: AddPackedBcdScore
units.summary: Unpack the two input BCD bytes at $2F/$30 into four low-first decimal digits, zero the remaining two addend digits, and add into the six unpacked score digits at $04DE. Carry is implemented explicitly because the NES has no decimal arithmetic; overflow beyond digit six is discarded. F1E1 selects physical PRG banks 0/1 for this call; the same CPU address in PRG pair six is a different routine.

units.name: ProcessSceneStripCommand
units.summary: Advance the scene command cursor. An inactive command returns; active commands select a two-byte record through $11, using either the saved index or the advancing cursor. The top two bits choose strip, scene-control or object-control updates. Strip records set or XOR one flag byte, locate the descriptor group through $05, synchronize with the frame consumer and continue into strip generation. Valid descriptor indices and map coordinates are local calling preconditions.

units.name: ApplySceneCommandFlags
units.summary: The low five bits select a scene-control byte. Bit five chooses XOR versus replacement.

units.name: ChooseSceneStripReplacement
units.summary: Return a replacement map byte in A and tile/attribute value in Y for the current strip cell. Horizontal and vertical cases use the command direction bits, old tile class and original flag bits to select empty, special terrain or alternate cells. The long decision tree is a finite tile policy, not a general decoder; the individual terrain IDs retain mechanical names where game meaning is unknown.

units.name: StartSceneCommandSequence
units.summary: Set the scene command cursor to $FF and request transition selector nine. The next command tick increments the cursor to zero.

units.name: ResetSceneCommandSequence
units.summary: Request transition selector zero, reset the scene command cursor to $FF and fall through into the previously reviewed continuation.

units.name: RequestSceneTransitionEleven
units.summary: Submit selector eleven to the fixed-bank transition helper, then fall through to the adjacent reviewed code.

units.name: InitializePasswordOverlay
units.summary: Choose the overlay palette/layout from the signed overlay selector, clear the attribute buffer and edit-state counters, and draw the selectable character grid. Paired pointer tables supply the expected and editable strings; their high-bit terminator is cleared after copying into RAM. Center the resulting length in a 32-column row, queue its upload, initialize selection state and enter the existing overlay loop. These CPU aliases are physical banks 8/9, independent of the same numeric addresses in other banks.

units.name: DrawPasswordGridCell
units.summary: Draw one selectable character as a two-by-two tile block at tile coordinates X/Y. Convert the location to a nametable address, enqueue both rows, merge the corresponding two-bit palette quadrant into the attribute shadow, then queue the changed attribute byte and commit the upload. Scratch is shared with the upload helpers.

units.name: TestPasswordAllowedBit
units.summary: Use the existing character-to-byte/bit helper, then test the corresponding bit in the $DB selection mask. Return the masked value in A; zero means the bit is clear.

units.name: ReloadAudioStreamPosition
units.summary: Reload the stream offset from the channel array and return to the common command loop. This is a command-handler continuation in physical banks 10/11.

units.name: SetAudioStreamPositionAndState
units.summary: Save the command's new stream offset, read its following byte into channel state $066E, and return to the common audio command loop.

units.name: SkipAudioCommandOperands
units.summary: Advance the current stream position by three bytes, save it and resume command decoding. The command dispatcher supplies the initial Y position.

units.name: AccumulateAudioModulationToLimit
units.summary: Add the indexed modulation increment to the incoming accumulator and compare with the channel target. On reaching or exceeding it, mark modulation state $40 and clamp to the target; store the resulting pitch-modulation output at $06F6. Carry on entry belongs to the adjacent handler contract.

units.name: FinishAudioModulationClamp
units.summary: Mark modulation complete with state $40, reload its target and fall through to the previously reviewed output store.

units.name: AssignCurrentSceneObjectType
units.summary: Copy the current scene object type with its high bit set into the selected object's type field and X, then return.

units.name: FinishChildHorizontalHighBorrow
units.summary: Propagate the incoming horizontal-position borrow into the parent's high coordinate and store the child slot's high byte. The adjacent reviewed code supplies parent X, child Y and the low-byte subtraction.

units.name: ResolvePlayerTerrainAction
units.summary: Choose player action/state transitions from sampled terrain IDs, held input and the previous-input mask. Several entries reverse facing or align the player to terrain before setting an action selector. The state flag distinguishes ordinary, attached and aligned movement; exact animation names remain uncertain. Object slot zero is the player; sampled coordinates and terrain dispatch selectors are supported local contracts, not proved natural domains.

units.name: UpdatePlayerSupportAttachment
units.summary: Keep the player attached only while the saved support object still overlaps the player. Transfer the support's signed movement into player fixed-point coordinates, or detach and select the appropriate terrain action. A shared movement helper integrates signed eighth-pixel X/Y deltas using fractional, low and high coordinate fields. Valid saved object slot and sampled map coordinates are entry preconditions.

units.name: ReloadCurrentObjectSlot
units.summary: Restore the current object index from the saved slot before the following reviewed handler body.

units.name: ObjectMotionAndTerrainHelpers
units.summary: Shared helpers clamp horizontal position to $0C..A, reverse facing or signed velocity, discard objects below the lower bound, and sample terrain at facing-relative offsets. Blocked terrain can trigger a child spawn before reversing movement. The alternate sample policy additionally treats tile $15 as blocking. Valid slots, frame-width indices and map coordinates are local requirements.

units.name: ObjectSpawnAndSupportPolicies
units.summary: Finish a child allocation by initializing its frame index and copying its parent-relative position, returning one on success and zero on allocation failure. Further entries initialize movement toward the player, delete objects on selected terrain, find a free map-backed support slot, and toggle animation frames with an eight-tick divider. These are connected finite object handlers; object names remain uncertain.

units.name: ObjectSideProbePolicies
units.summary: Probe terrain at fixed offsets relative to the object's frame width, reversing facing on selected tiles. One variant samples only when stationary vertically; another cycles eight vertical velocities through a three-tick divider before applying the same obstacle tests. Signed sample offsets are pixels; their validity is a caller precondition.

units.name: ObjectTerrainAndRetargetPolicies
units.summary: Connected object handlers apply side/top probes, bounded vertical bouncing, four-point terrain sampling and timed action transitions. A separate retargeting policy picks one of 32 position/velocity triples, rejects the player's coarse quadrant, then moves along an axis once aligned with the player. Timer and random branches control the changes; original object identities remain unresolved.

units.name: AdvanceObjectSequenceCursor
units.summary: Advance an object-local two-byte cursor by two when its divider expires, wrapping $26EE to $2400. Apply the packed action/facing byte, normalize horizontal velocity, clamp X and snap selected action classes to terrain-aligned coordinates. The cursor's external data interpretation remains unresolved.

units.name: ObjectTimedPlayerDirectionPolicy
units.summary: Initialize the object's X from a random offset near the player when entering from a nonzero high Y page, then clamp it. Probe below the object, snap its Y for selected terrain classes, and periodically choose horizontal velocity toward the player with a randomized timer. Update its action selector after each timer expiration.

units.name: DeleteObjectsInContactWindow
units.summary: Scan slots one through seven around the current object, excluding itself and specified type/action classes. A strict X window of plus/minus sixteen and Y window of plus/minus four selects objects for the common deletion helper. Restore the original slot before returning; byte arithmetic wraps as encoded.

units.name: PlayerTerrainResponseHandlers
units.summary: Finite terrain-selected player handlers test neighboring cells and choose state transitions, vertical alignment or attachment. Cases include random facing changes, signed horizontal strip motion and latch changes for special terrain. A reset helper clears the support index sentinel three; another restores sampled ground height for selected tile IDs. Selectors and valid map coordinates remain local Static preconditions.

units.name: PrepareAndSampleObjectTerrain
units.summary: Resolve the object's width pointer from its frame family, add half the current frame width to object X, and retain that center. The sampling entry adds or subtracts signed X offset according to facing, adds Y offset, invokes the bank-aware map sampler and restores the saved object index. Frame and coordinate bounds are required locally; out-of-range natural calls are unresolved.

units.name: AddNextScoreDigit
units.summary: Walk six low-first digits, subtract ten on overflow and propagate carry into the next digit. The addend scratch has two zero high digits.

units.name: AdvanceScoreWithoutCarry
units.summary: Continue with clear carry when the current decimal sum is below ten.

units.name: ReadActiveSceneCommand
units.summary: Select the saved or advancing record index and read its two bytes from the current command pointer.

units.name: ApplyStripCommandFlags
units.summary: Extract the five-bit strip index and write or XOR the selected strip flags. Locate its descriptor group before building changed map cells.

units.name: ApplySceneCommandFlags
units.summary: The low five bits select a scene-control byte. Bit five chooses XOR versus replacement.

units.name: ApplyObjectCommandFlags
units.summary: Split the command into operation and four-bit object index. Operation $10 returns its literal value with Y zero; the other operations replace or XOR the selected control byte.

units.name: BuildSceneStripUpload
units.summary: Unpack the two-byte map position, select replacement and attribute policies by descriptor group, and build a terminated page-one strip packet while updating RAM map cells.

units.name: AppendNextSceneStripCell
units.summary: Read the current map byte, choose replacement data and append one upload value. Preserve its original high flag and advance the map pointer for the next cell.

units.name: ChooseHorizontalAlternateCell
units.summary: For the alternate command mode, preserve recognized terrain classes or replace them with the paired flagged class and its attribute value.

units.name: ChooseHorizontalClearCell
units.summary: Clear unrecognized cells; preserve the special class with a flag-sensitive attribute value.

units.name: ChooseVerticalStripCell
units.summary: Advance the vertical cell coordinate. Descriptor group four uses a direct replacement pattern; other groups dispatch on command mode and terrain class.

units.name: ChooseVerticalPrimaryCell
units.summary: Clear the high map flag and choose special replacements for terrain pairs and alternating X parity. The previous map flag controls whether an attribute value is emitted.

units.name: ChooseVerticalFlaggedCell
units.summary: Set the high map flag and choose the alternate terrain/attribute pair, preserving the finite class comparisons used by the primary case.

units.name: ChooseVerticalClearCell
units.summary: Clear the high map flag and emit empty or unflagged terrain replacements; special terrain classes retain matching attributes.

units.name: ClearPasswordAttributeShadow
units.summary: Clear all 64 attribute-shadow bytes before populating the character grid.

units.name: DrawNextPasswordChoice
units.summary: Wait until the upload queue is available, choose the cell representation from the allowed-character masks, then draw it and walk the grid right to left.

units.name: LoadPasswordStringPair
units.summary: Wait for the queued grid updates, then load the expected and entered string pointers using the area selector. The negative selector uses pair forty.

units.name: CopyPasswordPairCharacters
units.summary: Copy paired characters until the expected character's high-bit terminator. Clear both final flags and retain the common length for centering.

units.name: MergePasswordCellAttribute
units.summary: Convert cell coordinates to an attribute byte/quadrant, shift the two-bit palette value into position and preserve the other three quadrants.

units.name: ResolvePlayerTurnAction
units.summary: Flip facing before testing player state and new input; choose the turn-specific action or reset the state.

units.name: ResolvePlayerHeldAction
units.summary: Use the same input edge/state gate without flipping facing; select action two when no special transition applies.

units.name: ResolvePlayerLeftTerrain
units.summary: Select action six for special sampled terrain, align to the left side of selected cells or fall back to the ordinary input gate.

units.name: AlignPlayerToLeftTerrain
units.summary: Snap the player's low X to the encoded left contact edge, select action nine and set movement state one.

units.name: TestPlayerCellInterior
units.summary: Require the low X nibble to be within five through eleven before selecting action fifteen.

units.name: ResolvePlayerRightTerrain
units.summary: Check new input first, then inspect the other terrain samples and align to their right contact edge when required.

units.name: AlignPlayerToRightTerrain
units.summary: Snap low X to the encoded right contact edge, select action ten and set movement state one.

units.name: AlignPlayerToCellStart
units.summary: Clear low X's bottom nibble and set movement state two after the shared special-terrain action.

units.name: DetachInvalidPlayerSupport
units.summary: Clear the saved support slot when the object's contact window no longer contains the player.

units.name: ApplyPlayerSupportMotion
units.summary: Mark supported terrain, select the support's transferable X/Y deltas and apply them to the player's fixed-point position. Special side terrain releases the attachment.

units.name: DetachPlayerOnSideTerrain
units.summary: Release support and restore sampled Y for the four explicitly accepted side-terrain classes.

units.name: ApplySignedPlayerSupportDelta
units.summary: Convert signed eighth-pixel X/Y movement into magnitude plus fractional bits. Add positive magnitudes or subtract negative magnitudes across fractional, low and high fields.

units.name: SubtractPlayerSupportX
units.summary: Negate the signed delta, split it into integer/fractional magnitude and subtract with borrow from the player's X fields.

units.name: ApplyPlayerSupportY
units.summary: Repeat the same signed fixed-point integration for player Y, including high-byte carry or borrow.

units.name: SubtractPlayerSupportY
units.summary: Subtract a negative support delta across the player's Y fraction, low byte and high page.

units.name: ReverseObjectFacingAndVelocity
units.summary: Flip both upper facing bits and normalize horizontal velocity to the resulting direction. Set the object palette selector/control byte to $80.

units.name: NormalizeObjectHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Take the velocity magnitude, negate it for negative facing and store the normalized signed speed.

units.name: NegateObjectVerticalVelocity
units.summary: Two's-complement the object's signed vertical velocity and set the palette selector/control byte to $80.

units.name: NegateObjectHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Two's-complement the object's signed horizontal velocity and set the palette selector/control byte to $80.

units.name: DeleteObjectBelowScreen
units.summary: Delete the current object when its low Y is at least $E0.

units.name: ProbeObjectBlockingTerrain
units.summary: Sample the facing-relative point and reverse on empty or selected blocking terrain classes. A low control value of two also requests a child spawn.

units.name: ReverseObjectAtObstacle
units.summary: Optionally seed a child command, then reverse the object's facing and normalize its horizontal velocity.

units.name: ProbeObjectAlternateBlockingTerrain
units.summary: Use the shared obstacle response but also recognize terrain $15 as blocking.

units.name: ReturnChildSpawnFailure
units.summary: Return zero when the allocator did not supply a valid child slot.

units.name: InitializeObjectTowardPlayer
units.summary: Clear high coordinates and seed small signed X/Y velocities toward the player's relative position, unless player state or frame cadence suppresses initialization.

units.name: DeleteObjectOnUpperTerrain
units.summary: Sample two pixels above the frame center and delete on either of the two specified terrain IDs.

units.name: FindObjectSupportMapSlot
units.summary: Set the support height, probe below, and require two RAM map cells to be empty before claiming the saved slot. Delete the old object and nearby contacts when the slot is available; otherwise select action fourteen.

units.name: ToggleObjectFramePair
units.summary: Use an eight-tick countdown to toggle a local frame bit and copy the selected frame to both pending and current selectors.

units.name: ProbeStationaryObjectSides
units.summary: When vertical velocity is zero, apply the lower side probe; always apply the upper probe and reverse on terrain fourteen.

units.name: CycleObjectVerticalProbe
units.summary: Cycle eight signed vertical velocities through a three-tick divider, then apply the lower and upper obstacle policies.

units.name: BounceObjectWithinVerticalBand
units.summary: Reverse vertical velocity at Y limits $18/$C0 or when the leading vertical probe hits one of five terrain IDs.

units.name: SampleObjectFourPointTerrain
units.summary: Decrement the action timer and sample below, ahead, above and center. Use these four terrain IDs to choose falling, reversal and delayed action changes.

units.name: MaybeTriggerObjectActionEleven
units.summary: When the timer is zero, reload it to $20 and let the random sign select whether action eleven is requested.

units.name: TriggerObjectActionEleven
units.summary: When the timer expires, reload $20 and select action eleven.

units.name: MaybeTriggerObjectActionTwelve
units.summary: On timer expiry and a nonnegative random byte, select action twelve and snap the object's X to the terrain edge.

units.name: MaybeTriggerObjectActionThirteen
units.summary: On timer expiry and a nonnegative random byte, select action thirteen and snap X using the same edge policy.

units.name: SnapObjectHorizontalTerrainEdge
units.summary: Round X down to an eight-pixel boundary; the retained bit-three phase selects whether to add seven.

units.name: RetargetObjectAcrossPlayerQuadrant
units.summary: For objects outside the base coordinate pages, periodically choose one of 32 packed positions and velocity pairs. Accept a candidate only when its coarse quadrant differs from the player's.

units.name: MoveObjectWhenPlayerAligned
units.summary: Once in the base pages, use player contact bounds to latch an aligned axis and set a signed speed of plus/minus $18 toward the player.

units.name: AdvanceObjectTwoByteCursor
units.summary: Increment the local cursor by two, wrapping its exact $26EE endpoint to $2400, then reset the divider.

units.name: ApplyObjectPackedActionFacing
units.summary: Split the packed byte into a six-bit action and two facing bits; normalize speed, clamp X and align selected action classes to terrain coordinates.

units.name: AlignObjectHorizontalPhase
units.summary: Round low X to an eight-pixel phase, then bias either side according to the preserved bit-three phase.

units.name: SnapObjectVerticalTerrainEdge
units.summary: Snap low Y for the listed ground classes before entering the timed horizontal response.

units.name: UpdateObjectRandomTurnTimer
units.summary: At timer expiry choose a speed of plus/minus four toward the player, reseed the timer and select action two. Initial entry may select action one instead.

units.name: TestPlayerLeftSpecialTerrain
units.summary: Suppress the shared response when the relevant samples are any of the explicitly exempt left-side terrain IDs.

units.name: TestPlayerRightSpecialTerrain
units.summary: Suppress the response for the corresponding right-side terrain IDs; otherwise call the shared response helper.

units.name: TestPlayerCenterSpecialTerrain
units.summary: Return for the three center terrain IDs. The alternate entry also checks the companion sample before falling back to the shared response.

units.name: TestPlayerCompanionSpecialTerrain
units.summary: Use the companion terrain sample for the same finite exemption set, then jump to the shared response.

units.name: ResolvePlayerGroundResponse
units.summary: Reset the latch, distinguish paired side terrain classes and select ordinary, aligned or strip-driven player movement. Valid sampled IDs and RAM map coordinates are required.

units.name: StartPlayerGroundActionThree
units.summary: Select action three, set the transition latch and reset the player movement state.

units.name: AlignPlayerVerticalTerrainPhase
units.summary: Use the low Y phase to choose an action or snap the player to the encoded contact edge.

units.name: LatchPlayerSpecialTerrain
units.summary: Set the special-terrain latch; clear its companion on the first transition only.

units.name: ApplyPlayerTerrainStripMovement
units.summary: Convert terrain IDs five through ten to a strip index. Choose signed X speed from strip direction and synchronize player X with the scene position when facing and action require it.

units.name: ResetSupportSentinel
units.summary: Convert support selector three to zero; leave every other selector unchanged.

units.name: RestorePlayerGroundForTerrain
units.summary: For terrain $11/$12/$0E, restore the sampled ground Y and return clear carry; all other IDs return set carry.

units.name: ResolvePlayerAboveGround
units.summary: Clear the special latch and restore ground for the accepted terrain IDs. Otherwise inspect height/state and side terrain, clear the transition latch on alignment or continue into the previously reviewed response.

units.name: SampleObjectFacingRelativeTerrain
units.summary: Use X/Y as signed sample offsets about the prepared object center. Facing chooses X addition or subtraction; the bank-aware sampler supplies the terrain class and $07 map pointer, then the saved object slot is restored.

units.name: AreaResourceDescriptorBytes
units.summary: 58 contiguous twelve-byte area resource descriptor records. The EF49 consumer uses fields four/five as a source pointer and copies 222 bytes after selecting PRG pair five. Repeated record layout and neighbor/consumer checks support non-code; the complete natural selector domain and original record schema remain unresolved.

units.name: AreaParameterImageSlice_0169D3
units.summary: Slice of the union of 222-byte source images copied by EFB2 into RAM $0377..$0454 after selecting physical PRG banks 10/11. Existing classified spans split the union into these exact intervals. Overlaps do not imply separate original records; field meanings and the full original resource layout remain unresolved. Saved eight-pointer/consumer and boundary checks support generic Data.

units.name: PlayerTerrainActionPointers
units.summary: Sixteen split low/high CPU handler pointers, selected by A153 after masking to four bits. Low bytes precede high bytes, sixteen bytes each; the following executable A1A3 fixes the upper boundary. Physical PRG banks 12/13 supply these targets. Natural selection is separate from this bounded representation.

units.name: ObjectTypeHandlerPointerBytes
units.summary: Split object-type handler bytes: 87 low entries and 87 matching high entries support the finite type 0..86 static contract. Two additional high bytes remain generic non-code; indices 87/88 would pair with following executable low bytes and are not accepted handler slots. The original unrestricted selector domain is unresolved.

units.name: PlayerTerrainResponsePointers
units.summary: Seventeen split low/high handler pointers consumed by E07D. The following E0AF routine fixes the end. Terrain selectors 0..16 form the supported local Static dispatch contract; the game naturally maintaining that domain is unresolved.

units.name: SceneMapRowPointers
units.summary: 32 split low/high row pointers indexed by the sampler after three right shifts. Rows 4..23 point to twenty RAM rows; the exact sequence includes $01B8 then $0200, so it is not a uniform-stride array. Other rows select the ROM sentinel at CPU $E3BC. Map writes require a RAM row and valid horizontal coordinates; unrestricted sampler input does not prove that precondition.

units.name: HudDigitPairPointersAndDestinations
units.summary: Two parallel ten-word arrays: little-endian RAM digit-pair pointers followed by PPU destinations. The consumer starts at offsets zero or fourteen, advances by two and stops when the destination high byte is zero at offsets twelve/eighteen. These exact consumer bounds cover forty bytes; unused values do not establish a larger original schema.

units.name: HudSymbolTileBytes
units.summary: Two eleven-byte top/bottom HUD tile arrays read by the digit-pair renderer. The following F1C4 bank-save helper fixes the boundary. The full eleven-symbol natural index domain is unresolved, so the bytes retain generic Data rather than an asserted complete glyph set.

units.name: AddDecimalCounterWithSharedCarry
units.summary: Add A to the decimal pair at $04C6/$04C7. Carry past 99 increments the shared saturated pair at $04C4/$04C5. The neighboring entry points increment, decrement or add to other decimal pairs; callers supply small decimal addends, not arbitrary binary bytes.

units.name: AddSaturatedDecimalPair
units.summary: Add A to the low decimal digit at $04CA; propagate decimal carry into $04CB and saturate both digits to nine on overflow. The caller supplies a decimal addend small enough for one normalization per digit.

units.name: IncrementBoundedCounter
units.summary: Increment $04E5 up to nine. This is a bounded counter; its precise inventory meaning is unresolved.

units.name: SelectGridStatusPacket
units.summary: Unless the display latch is active, decrement the three-state status timer and select one of six queue packets from timer and mode. Negative selection suppresses the update; each packet is installed through the bank-preserving queue wrapper.

units.name: EnsureGridSoundAndDispatchMode
units.summary: Request sound $22 if it is not already current, then choose the ordinary grid input handler or the alternate mode path from the mode flag.

units.name: AcceptGridSelection
units.summary: Flatten the grid cursor, reject unavailable selections, then either clear the selected availability bit and start a transition or mark the current selection and start its feedback timer. Set the common acceptance delay after either accepted path.

units.name: MoveWrappedGridCursor
units.summary: Interpret the grid buttons, routing action buttons to their existing handlers. Direction bits move row/column independently; wrap rows by the configured row count and columns modulo ten, then redraw the cursor.

units.name: ClearGridConfirmationLatch
units.summary: Clear the grid confirmation latch and return to its caller.

units.name: RestoreGridSelectionAndRedraw
units.summary: After the nested input path, clear the display latch, recover the saved selection from the stack and redraw its state. Entry requires the matching earlier push; this is an interior continuation.

units.name: ReturnFromGridUpdate
units.summary: Return from the surrounding grid update. No independent parameter or semantic contract follows from this single return instruction.

units.name: ReturnFromGridDraw
units.summary: Return from the surrounding grid drawing path; setup is provided by its existing callers.

units.name: LatchGridDisplayComplete
units.summary: Raise the display latch after the surrounding operation finishes.

units.name: FlattenGridCursor
units.summary: Form row*10+column in scratch. For the upper selection family, add 29 before returning the index; cursor bounds remain the caller's contract.

units.name: SetGridVisitedBit
units.summary: Use the common selection-to-mask helper and set the corresponding bit in the visited-bit array.

units.name: UpdateGridSelectionBitsets
units.summary: Use the common mask/index helper to clear an availability bit or test/set one of two independent progression bitsets. These are separate entry points; the original names of the latter two flag families remain unresolved.

units.name: AdvanceGridPacketPointerPage
units.summary: Carry the source-pointer increment into its high byte. This continues the existing packet builder rather than initializing a new pointer.

units.name: QueueGridStatusPacket
units.summary: Point the queue source at the fixed grid-status packet and tail-call the bank-preserving queue wrapper.

units.name: DrawGridDecorationsAndCyclePalette
units.summary: Draw two alternate rectangle sprites at fixed positions, then cycle a twelve-tick phase through three three-byte palette records. The renderer requires its established family and dimension contract.

units.name: ReturnFromGridEffect
units.summary: Return from the selected grid effect path; the surrounding effect dispatcher supplies the entry contract.

units.name: KeepEarlierObjectEvent
units.summary: Given event A and priority/time Y, replace the object's saved pair only when no pair is active or the new Y precedes it. The existing tail completes the update.

units.name: ApplyObjectSupportProperty
units.summary: Extract the high nibble of the object's type property and install it in the bounded target slot. Subsequent command entries add score/counters or toggle the object's display flag from script operands.

units.name: MaskObjectScriptFlags
units.summary: Provide AND/OR operations on the object's script flags and replace the low two bits of its render/control flags. The following type test shares the surrounding command tail.

units.name: ApplyObjectScriptParameters
units.summary: Set the per-object parameter, request script-selected sound while restoring the interpreter slot, or place this object relative to a selected object's low X/Y coordinates. Offset arithmetic intentionally wraps those byte fields.

units.name: SetScriptFrameOrReturn
units.summary: Pass the first script operand to the existing frame initializer. A neighboring no-op entry returns without changing interpreter state.

units.name: ClearObjectControlHighBit
units.summary: Clear bit seven of the object's control field and continue into its established shared tail.

units.name: SetObjectBytePosition
units.summary: Install the two script operand bytes as low X and Y. This command does not update the separate X high byte.

units.name: RemoveSelectedObjects
units.summary: Scan the eight object slots. A nonnegative operand removes matching types; a negative operand removes every active slot except the current interpreter object. Restore the selector after each removal call.

units.name: ReplaceObjectPreservingPosition
units.summary: Save four position/orientation bytes, remove the old object and allocate its replacement. The supported returning path requires allocation success so all four stack bytes are popped into the new slot; the encoded failure path leaves them pushed. Set the interpreter-stop marker afterwards.

units.name: ReturnAfterScriptPredicate
units.summary: Continue after a predicate satisfying the interpreter-preservation contract. Both carry outcomes return here; this does not establish arbitrary indirect predicate behavior or uninitialized saved-return/loop state.

units.name: BroadcastObjectEvent
units.summary: Visit all eight slots and feed event/priority operands to the earliest-event helper. A nonnegative type selects matches; a negative type selects every slot except the interpreter object.

units.name: ObjectOrientationSubcommands
units.summary: Implement the selected orientation subcommands: set/toggle both high bits, clear/set/toggle bit seven, return unchanged, or derive bit seven from nonzero horizontal motion. Only the established ten-entry subcommand domain is claimed.

units.name: RestartObjectScriptFrame
units.summary: Restart the frame from the saved frame field and clear its delay, or start the frame selected by the first script operand. These are separate entries sharing the frame initializer.

units.name: TestSpecialPlacementKind
units.summary: Compare the current placement kind with two before rejoining the existing object command branch.

units.name: JoinObjectCommandTail
units.summary: Jump to the already established shared command tail; no independent lower-window bank is inferred.

units.name: SpawnLimitedType19Companion
units.summary: Scan slots seven through one for type $19 and remember the greatest link value. If at least two exist, remove that candidate before allocating another. Initialize the new slot above and beside the player, with orientation-dependent X placement; failed allocation exits without writing a slot.

units.name: StopWhenFacingInputDisagrees
units.summary: Compare left/right input with the object's orientation. Rejoin the existing accepted-facing path or clear horizontal motion when neither direction matches.

units.name: ReloadConditionalObjectTimer
units.summary: Reload the shared timer to 120 when the mode byte is nonnegative; otherwise leave it unchanged.

units.name: PredicateObjectLatchClear
units.summary: Return carry set exactly when the shared latch at $69 is zero. The byte value in A is retained for callers inspecting it.

units.name: PlaceObjectAtScreenApproach
units.summary: Clear the mode/latch, reload the shared timer, and choose initial Y by area. Place the object on one side of the camera boundary and set its facing accordingly, using full low/high X arithmetic.

units.name: PredicateModeNonnegative
units.summary: Return carry set for a nonnegative mode byte and clear for a negative byte. This is a mechanical predicate, not a named gameplay state.

units.name: OrientAndPushAwayFromPlayer
units.summary: Clear the transition byte, set the object's control high bit and compare its full X with the player slot. Select signed horizontal motion and orientation on the right-side case; the left-side case installs positive motion without clearing orientation.

units.name: SetObjectModeOne
units.summary: Set the shared object mode to one.

units.name: SetObjectParameterFour
units.summary: Install four in the object's parameter field; its game-specific interpretation remains unresolved.

units.name: SetObjectY139
units.summary: Set the object's Y byte to $8B.

units.name: AttachPlayerToNegativeStateObject
units.summary: A preceding entry sets Y to $82. The attachment entry clears the latch and reports carry set unless the object's state is negative; on success, copy orientation, full X and horizontal motion to the player and return carry clear.

units.name: ConsumeProgressionCounterNibble
units.summary: Test whether progression bits $30 are present. The action entry subtracts $10 when nonzero and adds one through the PRG-pair-zero saturated decimal counter wrapper.

units.name: CopyPlayerFacingAndTestScriptFlags
units.summary: Copy the selected player's orientation to this object. Separate predicate entries test the sign bit and the nonzero low-seven-bit portion of the object's script flags, returning the result in carry.

units.name: TestAndClearProgressionHighBit
units.summary: Test a progression byte's high bit in carry. The action entry sets the shared redraw latch and clears that high bit in the selected byte.

units.name: RecordPackedPositionHistory
units.summary: Test/clear progression bit $40, or consume a bounded counter and shift two prior three-byte position records. Pack full X divided by eight with Y and area, then invalidate an older record whose area matches the current area's small equivalence chain. Carry set reports unavailable counter; carry clear reports a recorded position.

units.name: DecrementProgressionLowNibble
units.summary: Find the current progression byte and subtract one only when its low nibble is nonzero. Higher bits remain unchanged for the supported nonzero case.

units.name: TestAndSetProgressionLatchE6
units.summary: Predicate returns carry set when the latch at $04E6 is clear; the neighboring action sets it to one.

units.name: TestAndSetProgressionLatchE4
units.summary: Predicate returns carry set when the latch at $04E4 is clear; the neighboring action sets it to one.

units.name: TestObjectDistanceOrState
units.summary: While the shared timer is zero, test a low-byte horizontal separation threshold or the object's nonnegative state and nonzero motion. The second predicate sets the shared latch on success. Incoming carry participates in the first subtraction and remains part of its local predicate contract.

units.name: MoveAndRecordControlledObject
units.summary: For negative object state, update its packed position record and move Y within the encoded limits from up/down input. Other entries compare area $10, attach the player and set a mode latch, or pack the object's full X divided by eight and Y into the selected two-byte record. The record index is supplied by the object's script flags.

units.name: IncrementObjectLinkUntilFF
units.summary: Increment the object's link/priority byte unless it already equals $FF.

units.name: PushObjectTowardFacingPlayer
units.summary: Require the encoded vertical proximity band, then compare full X with the selected player slot. If orientation points toward that player, install signed horizontal motion and return carry clear; otherwise return carry set. Incoming carry affects the first difference as encoded.

units.name: ClearPredicateCarryTail
units.summary: Clear carry before entering the existing shared predicate return. This is an interior tail, not a standalone object behavior.

units.name: SetPredicateCarryAndReturn
units.summary: Return a true predicate result in carry from the surrounding comparison path.

units.name: PredicateFacingTerrainClass
units.summary: Sample terrain at a motion-dependent horizontal point and the object's Y. Sentinel $FF and ordinary classes take the existing false tail; classes one and two return carry set. The fixed sampler explicitly restores the bank required by this continuation.

units.name: TestDistanceAndApplySignedOffsets
units.summary: Test whether full X is within 64 of player zero. A separate command entry applies the signed script X offset across both X bytes, then adds the Y offset with byte wrap; a negative X operand is converted to magnitude in scratch before subtraction.

units.name: JoinExistingPredicateResult
units.summary: If the preceding negative-velocity increment reaches zero, branch back and increment again to cross zero. Otherwise return. Flags from that increment are part of this interior entry contract.

units.name: OffsetObjectYBy16
units.summary: Add sixteen to the object's Y byte with wrap.

units.name: CompareObjectYWith88
units.summary: Compare the object's Y byte with $58 and return the comparison flags.

units.name: TogglePrimaryObjectSceneLatch
units.summary: For object type zero only, set the scene latch to three or clear it. Other types return without changing the latch.

units.name: PredicateSceneFlagSet
units.summary: Return the nonzero state of the scene flag at $03EE in carry.

units.name: PredicateObjectFlagBit3Clear
units.summary: Return carry set when bit three of the object's script flags is clear.

units.name: SetOrClearAuxiliaryObjectAction
units.summary: Set the object's auxiliary packed-action field to one or zero through two selected entries.

units.name: PeriodicAuxiliaryTimerPredicates
units.summary: Decrement the auxiliary object timer. On expiry, reload it to forty, twenty or eight according to entry and return carry set; other ticks return carry clear. A zero starting timer wraps before the test.

units.name: TestPlayerBandAndTerrainMotion
units.summary: First test a vertical player band and relative-facing condition. A separate predicate probes terrain above/below the object, rejects the enumerated classes and compares orientations; rejected probes clear horizontal motion and carry. Probe helpers must preserve the saved object-slot contract.

units.name: ProbeAndAlterObjectTerrain
units.summary: Test the terrain below the object against classes $0B/$0E. A related action performs its setup, skips class $0E and otherwise requests a tile change near the object's low-byte coordinates. The tile-change helper explicitly restores the required bank.

units.name: PlaceObjectAbovePlayer
units.summary: Copy the player's low X byte and place this object's Y eight pixels above the player's. The X high byte remains unchanged.

units.name: ResetCameraAndSceneScratch
units.summary: After the scene helper returns, clear camera X, scroll state and local scratch before entering the existing scene setup. Lower-window context remains whatever the caller/callee contract actually establishes.

units.name: SelectSceneUpload17
units.summary: Request scene upload $17 in mode one, then continue the existing scene initialization. This continuation does not assume the callee preserves unknown lower banks.

units.name: InitializeProgressionSession
units.summary: Clear progression latches/bitsets and decimal counters, choose the starting area from the mode, initialize packed history and seed progression bytes to $FF. The intervening loader/PPU calls retain their local return contracts; this fixed code does not infer unknown lower-window bodies.

units.name: DispatchSceneTransitions
units.summary: After per-frame setup, route completion, reset and encoded transition states. Preserve/restore transition coordinates around loaders, distinguish ordinary and special scene families, and reset transient latches on entry. Lower-window calls with unknown return banks leave those aliases unresolved; only fixed-bank continuations are supported there.

units.name: FinishTransitionByteLoop
units.summary: Complete the existing reverse-copy loop and jump to the shared session restart path. The loop's source and destination are initialized before this continuation.

units.name: FindNearbySceneTransition
units.summary: Convert the selected object's full X to coarse units and retain Y. Scan PRG-pair-four five-byte records: coarse X, Y, destination kind and two destination coordinates; zero first byte ends the list. Accept proximity below three coarse columns and 24 vertical units, apply destination-specific flag checks, restore PRG pair six and return the transition result. Separate helpers capture current coordinates and test special transition availability.

units.name: RestartAfterCompletionPrompt
units.summary: Run completion setup and clear temporary display state, then branch on the prompt result to restart the session or reuse initialized state. Fixed-bank continuation remains valid even when lower return banks are unresolved.

units.name: RestartSessionAndClearDisplayScratch
units.summary: Provide the alternate restart path, or run setup and the scene sequence before returning to session initialization. The shared helper clears six temporary display bytes.

units.name: FinishDisplayScratchRestore
units.summary: Finish the surrounding reverse-indexed display restore and return. Its source contract is established by the earlier entry.

units.name: LoadOrdinaryOrSpecialScene
units.summary: Preserve the selector across setup and initialize either ordinary scene mode one or special scene mode two. Invoke the relevant map/resource loader, scene objects, display and palette helpers, and reset the shared object mode. Ordinary scenes may set the completion latch from the returned result; special scenes use their distinct selector and state path.

units.name: LoadResetSceneMode
units.summary: Select scene mode three and run its resource, display, text and object setup before joining the common post-load tail. Lower-bank aliases are inferred only where explicit bank selections establish them.

units.name: WaitForStartPressAndRelease
units.summary: Wait through the encoded Start release/press/release sequence, servicing the shared frame helper between polls. Clear upper control bits afterwards and continue frame service.

units.name: ServiceFrameWithDelay
units.summary: Service banked audio, wait for the frame handshake byte to clear, mark it pending, execute the finite delay loop and tail-call the raster service. This is synchronization, not a measured wall-clock delay claim.

units.name: FinishSevenByteQueueRecord
units.summary: Append seven bytes from the active source cursor into the RAM queue, repeat for the remaining record count and add the $FF terminator. Save queue extent and explicitly restore PRG pair six. Source bank and initial cursor remain caller contracts.

units.name: InitializeDisplaySequence
units.summary: Run display reset, select resource $10 and initialize its timing/palette sequence. Continue through the shared display helper; no title or ending meaning is asserted solely from the resource number.

units.name: RepeatDisplayWaitSequence
units.summary: Wait with the $FF timeout, service the display and re-enter the common timed sequence.

units.name: FinishDisplayInitialization
units.summary: Run the two display setup helpers and tail-call the timed delay with 120 ticks.

units.name: ResetAroundScenePreview
units.summary: Reset the display around the scene-preview loader, then join the common presentation sequence.

units.name: AnimateDecreasingDisplayCounter
units.summary: Select display record $83, initialize timing/sound and a small sprite state, then repeatedly subtract an increasing step from the counter. Service animation and frames until subtraction underflows; run the final delay and display cleanup afterwards.

units.name: RenderImmediateSceneText
units.summary: The first entry chains two display helpers. The text entry selects the immediate PRG-pair-one string list at $B858, renders it and waits twenty ticks. Pointer identity is physical PRG-pair-one data, not a fixed-window alias.

units.name: SequenceSceneDisplayRecords
units.summary: Play a fixed sequence of scene display records, timed waits and two rectangle/list sources with distinct control values. A second entry sets the mode flag and plays its alternate record sequence. These are presentation scripts; the original scene names remain unresolved.

units.name: JoinDisplayCounterAnimation
units.summary: Join the common timed display-counter animation after the surrounding scene sequence.

units.name: RunCountdownConfirmationPrompt
units.summary: Draw the prompt and decimal countdown from ten through zero. Each number gets four timed input checks; return zero on exhaustion or one on acceptance after common cleanup. A helper builds the two decimal digits and queues them at the fixed PPU destination.

units.name: InitializeScenePreview
units.summary: Reset the display and resources, initialize scene mode two with selector $80, then continue the existing preview tail. The numeric lower-window call remains unresolved if no bank is established.

units.name: JoinDisplayResetTail
units.summary: Tail-call the shared display reset after the surrounding sequence finishes.

units.name: WaitForStartOrTimeout
units.summary: Store timeout A and poll Start while servicing frames. Return the expired counter on timeout; on Start, wait for release, clear timeout and return one. The timer is serviced by the existing frame path.

units.name: RestoreBankSixAfterUpload
units.summary: Explicitly select PRG pair six after the surrounding upload operation. No preservation of the preceding lower bank is implied.

units.name: WaitForDisplayReady
units.summary: Clear the display latch and service frame/display helpers until the readiness predicate becomes nonzero.

units.name: BuildSpecialSceneCoordinateDisplay
units.summary: A preceding entry returns. The setup entry selects an upload and writes a compact RAM display record from high nibbles of current/saved areas, with fixed separators and terminators. Initialize its display/scroll helpers and install the record through the existing pointer wrapper.

units.name: LoadAreaAndInitializeObjects
units.summary: Normalize the area selector to the encoded range, clear the area workspace, select PRG pair two and load its parameters. Initialize scene flags, map/resource state and object records, then hide OAM sprites, DMA page seven and install the three fixed resource pointer groups. Selector validity within called tables remains a local contract.

units.name: SpawnAreaObjectList
units.summary: Create the primary object, record its slot and apply the scene flag. Walk the selected type/placement pairs until $FF, spawn each object, adjust its terrain placement and dispatch its initializer. Placement kind two enters the separate PPU setup path; list/index validity is supplied by the area loader.

units.name: InitializeSpecialPlacementAndDispatch
units.summary: Initialize seven PPU destinations and write the two special placement bytes. The separate initializer dispatcher reads paired targets for object types zero through 77; that finite local contract is independent of the wider object-update type domain.

units.name: InitializeObjectModeAndOffsets
units.summary: Selected initializer entries set the object's state, shift Y, set the display flag, initialize divider/timer or use a slot-indexed initial timer. At E652, the return opcode is also the index-zero table byte; following slot-one-through-seven values remain Data.

units.name: InitializeObjectTimerBySlot
units.summary: Load the object's initial timer from the slot-indexed table whose base is this routine's return opcode. Slots one through seven read the following Data bytes; slot zero mechanically reads the RTS byte.

units.name: InitializeObjectOffsetAndTimerVariants
units.summary: Selected initializer entries add or subtract fixed Y offsets and set the display flag. The last entry loads a slot-dependent timer from a table based on its return opcode; the next seven bytes remain Data.

units.name: InitializeObjectMotionAndTerrainPlacement
units.summary: Initialize sentinel position/fraction and motion fields, or shift Y before loading the per-area/per-slot frame. The frame helper explicitly selects PRG pair six then restores PRG pair two. A separate placement helper probes a type-dependent vertical offset and shifts the object only when the sampled terrain is empty.

units.name: ChooseAreaDependentObjectState
units.summary: For later areas, install state twelve; otherwise inspect the current action count and vertical separation from the player to select states $19/$39. Existing tails handle cases outside those thresholds.

units.name: AdvanceResourcePointerPage
units.summary: Carry the existing resource-pointer increment into its high byte. The low-byte increment and loop setup precede this continuation.

units.name: BankZeroDecimalCounterWrappers
units.summary: Save/select PRG pair zero, invoke the decimal counter helper and restore the caller's bank. A second entry increments the shared decimal pair and requests display update $10 after restoration.

units.name: DecrementDecimalPairAndReport
units.summary: Use the PRG-pair-zero decrement helper, restore the bank and select sound/display feedback from its zero/nonzero result. A separate entry wraps the second decimal add helper; natural counter meanings remain unresolved.

units.name: BankZeroSaturatedCounterWrapper
units.summary: Save/select PRG pair zero, add through the saturated decimal pair helper and restore the previous bank.

units.name: BankZeroBoundedCounterWrapper
units.summary: Save/select PRG pair zero, increment the counter capped at nine and restore the previous bank.

units.name: CopySelectedFiveByteRecord
units.summary: Split selector A into three encoded resource families, explicitly select PRG pair two or four and resolve a paired pointer. Copy exactly five bytes into RAM $0200..$0204, then enter the shared bank wrapper. The valid selector ranges and pointer domain remain caller preconditions.

units.name: RenderTextAndRestoreWrapperBank
units.summary: Render the active text source through the fixed text helper, then restore the bank expected by the shared wrapper.

units.name: TestGridAvailabilityThroughWrapper
units.summary: Switch through the shared bank wrapper, test the selection availability bit and tail-restore the previous bank while retaining the result.

units.name: ProgressionBitsetBankWrappers
units.summary: Provide test/set wrappers for two distinct grid progression bitsets, selecting their bank through the shared helper and restoring it afterwards. Keep the two bitset families separate even though their exact gameplay names remain unresolved.

units.name: RestorePlayerXAndStopHorizontalMotion
units.summary: Restore the player's full X from the collision rollback copy and clear horizontal motion. Y and the saved rollback bytes are unchanged.

units.name: IncrementSharedDecimalPair
units.summary: Increment the shared low/high decimal pair, saturating at 99. Decimal overflow from the other add helpers also enters here.

units.name: DecrementSharedDecimalPair
units.summary: Subtract one from the decimal pair, borrowing through the high digit and clamping underflow to zero. Return A=1 at zero, A=0 otherwise.

units.name: AddSecondaryDecimalPair
units.summary: Add A to the second decimal pair with decimal carry into the shared pair on overflow. Once its high digit reaches four, clear its low digit as encoded; do not assume an ordinary modulo-100 counter.

units.name: TestGridProgressionBitsetOne
units.summary: Return the selected bit from the first progression array in A.

units.name: SetGridProgressionBitsetOne
units.summary: Set the selected bit in the first progression array.

units.name: TestGridProgressionBitsetTwo
units.summary: Return the selected bit from the second progression array in A.

units.name: SetGridProgressionBitsetTwo
units.summary: Set the selected bit in the second progression array.

units.name: ScriptAddPackedScore
units.summary: Stage the two score operand bytes in the decimal scratch pair and invoke the PRG-pair-zero six-digit score wrapper.

units.name: ScriptAddDecimalCounter
units.summary: Pass the first script operand to the first decimal-counter wrapper.

units.name: ScriptAddSecondaryDecimalCounter
units.summary: Pass the first script operand to the second decimal-counter wrapper.

units.name: ScriptSetDisplayFlagFromOperand
units.summary: Set sprite/control bit $20 when the operand is zero, otherwise clear it.

units.name: ScriptOrTerrainFlags
units.summary: OR the script operand into the object's terrain/script flags.

units.name: ScriptReplaceSpriteLowBits
units.summary: Replace the low two sprite-attribute bits with the operand. Operand validity is a script contract; it is not masked here.

units.name: ScriptTestPrimaryObjectType
units.summary: Test the object's type before joining the existing conditional command tail.

units.name: ScriptRequestAudio
units.summary: Request the operand-selected audio entry and reload the interpreter object slot after the call.

units.name: ScriptCopyRelativeObjectPosition
units.summary: Read object index from operand zero and offset its low X/Y by the next two operands. Each component wraps independently.

units.name: ScriptNoOperationReturn
units.summary: Return without further mutation from the selected command.

units.name: RemoveAllOtherActiveObjects
units.summary: Scan the slots, preserving the current interpreter object and removing the other active objects.

units.name: BroadcastEventToOtherObjects
units.summary: Apply the event to every slot except the current interpreter object. The earliest-event helper owns replacement priority semantics.

units.name: SubcommandToggleFacingPair
units.summary: Toggle orientation bits $C0.

units.name: SubcommandClearFacingHighBit
units.summary: Clear orientation bit seven.

units.name: SubcommandSetFacingHighBit
units.summary: Set orientation bit seven.

units.name: SubcommandToggleFacingHighBit
units.summary: Toggle orientation bit seven.

units.name: SubcommandReturnUnchanged
units.summary: Selected no-op subcommand; return immediately.

units.name: SubcommandFacingFromMotion
units.summary: When horizontal motion is nonzero, replace the orientation byte with its sign bit. Zero motion retains the existing orientation.

units.name: ScriptStartOperandFrame
units.summary: Initialize the frame selected by the first script operand.

units.name: PredicateLatchIsClear
units.summary: Return true in carry when the preceding latch test was zero.

units.name: PlaceObjectLeftOfCamera
units.summary: Clear facing and subtract 64 from full camera X to obtain the initial object X.

units.name: PushObjectRight
units.summary: Install positive horizontal motion; retain the existing facing flags on this branch.

units.name: AttachPlayerToObjectIfNegativeState
units.summary: Clear the latch and return carry set for nonnegative object state. Otherwise copy full X, facing and horizontal motion to the selected player, set the latch and return carry clear.

units.name: ConsumeProgressionCounterUnit
units.summary: Subtract $10 only when the selected two-bit progression counter is nonzero, then add one to the decimal pair through its bank wrapper.

units.name: PredicateTerrainHighBitClear
units.summary: Return carry set when the object's terrain/script flags have a clear high bit.

units.name: PredicateTerrainLowBitsNonzero
units.summary: Return carry set when any of the object's low seven terrain/script bits is set.

units.name: ClearProgressionHighBit
units.summary: Set the shared action countdown/latch to one and clear the selected progression byte's high bit.

units.name: ClearProgressionBitSix
units.summary: Clear progression bit $40 and increment the bounded counter through its wrapper.

units.name: ConsumeCounterAndRecordPosition
units.summary: Require a nonzero bounded counter, then shift history, pack current coordinates and mark the history update. Return carry set if unavailable.

units.name: SetProgressionLatchE6
units.summary: Set the progression latch to one.

units.name: SetProgressionLatchE4
units.summary: Set the independent progression latch to one.

units.name: PredicateMotionStateReady
units.summary: Require zero shared timer, nonnegative state and nonzero contact-response field; set the shared latch and carry when ready.

units.name: CompareAreaWith16
units.summary: Compare the current area with $10 and return flags.

units.name: LatchPlayerAttachmentMode
units.summary: Try the player attachment helper; after a successful carry-clear result, mark its mode latch negative and update the packed position record.

units.name: StorePackedObjectPosition
units.summary: Use the object's terrain/script byte as a record index; pack full X divided by eight with Y into two bytes and return carry clear. A valid record index remains an entry contract.

units.name: RejectFacingPlayerPush
units.summary: Return carry set when the proximity or facing requirement fails.

units.name: ScriptApplySignedPositionOffsets
units.summary: Apply signed X operand two across both X bytes and add Y operand three with wrap. Negative X conversion overwrites that operand scratch byte.

units.name: ClearPrimaryObjectSceneLatch
units.summary: Clear the scene latch only for type zero.

units.name: ClearAuxiliaryObjectAction
units.summary: Clear the auxiliary action field for this slot.

units.name: PredicateAuxiliaryTimer20
units.summary: Reload the auxiliary timer to twenty on expiry; carry reports the expiry tick.

units.name: PredicateAuxiliaryTimer8
units.summary: Reload the auxiliary timer to eight on expiry; carry reports the expiry tick.

units.name: PredicateTerrainAllowsFacingMotion
units.summary: Save the slot, probe two points and reject the enumerated terrain classes. Matching facing returns the retained carry; rejection clears velocity and carry.

units.name: ProbeTerrainBelowObject
units.summary: Initialize the object probe and tail-call its sampler one unit below the object.

units.name: ReplaceTerrainBelowObject
units.summary: Run the setup and probe, then request a replacement unless terrain class $0E was read. Coordinates use the object's low bytes plus encoded offsets.

units.name: ProcessEncodedSceneTransition
units.summary: Check the nearby transition result and divide its negative destination kind into ordinary and special families.

units.name: LoadSpecialTransitionFamily
units.summary: Mask the encoded destination kind, preserve it across reset and invoke the special scene loader.

units.name: CaptureCurrentTransitionCoordinates
units.summary: Capture selected object Y and coarse full X. If the pending transition latch is set, replace the outgoing transition coordinates with the fixed fallback Y.

units.name: UseFallbackTransitionCoordinates
units.summary: Set outgoing Y to forty and copy current coarse X and area into the transition fields; return zero.

units.name: ScanNearbyTransitionRecords
units.summary: Capture coordinates, then scan the selected five-byte PRG-pair-four transition records unless the pending-state byte is negative.

units.name: ApplyMatchedTransitionRecord
units.summary: Copy destination kind and coordinates, restore PRG pair six and perform family-specific availability checks before accepting the transition.

units.name: TestSpecialTransitionAvailability
units.summary: Use destination subfamily to choose the progression-bit predicate; the ordinary subgroup can consume a decimal resource and set the progression bit before accepting.

units.name: RestartFromSceneSequence
units.summary: Run scene setup, presentation and resource service, then re-enter session initialization after the reset call.

units.name: ClearTemporaryScoreDisplay
units.summary: Clear the six temporary display digits at $04DE..$04E3.

units.name: LoadSpecialSceneMode
units.summary: Set special mode two, clear completion state, preserve selector across resource setup, then initialize the special scene display and object state.

units.name: RenderBankOneImmediateText
units.summary: Render the PRG-pair-one text list at $B858, then wait twenty ticks.

units.name: RunAlternatePresentationSequence
units.summary: Set the alternate mode flag and play its fixed scene-record and delay sequence.

units.name: AcceptCountdownPrompt
units.summary: Clean up and return A=1 after an accepted input check.

units.name: CheckCountdownPromptInput
units.summary: Select display/control value $2E, then enter the fifteen-tick Start-or-timeout helper.

units.name: DrawCountdownDigits
units.summary: Convert countdown ten to digits 1/0 or a single low digit, set the fixed PPU destination and tail-call the digit-pair renderer.

units.name: WaitForStartRelease
units.summary: Keep servicing controller/frame work until Start releases, clear timeout and return one.

units.name: BuildSpecialSceneDisplayRecord
units.summary: Build the compact display record and invoke its display/pointer helpers.

units.name: InitializeNormalizedArea
units.summary: Disable rendering/requests, clear the area workspace and load PRG-pair-two area resources before object/display setup.

units.name: DispatchObjectInitializer
units.summary: Double object type and read one paired CPU target. Only types zero through 77 have established initializer entries; the wider update table is independent.

units.name: ObjectInitializerNoOperation
units.summary: Return from initializer types selecting the no-op target before the pointer table.

units.name: InitializeObjectYMinus4
units.summary: Shift this object's Y upward by four.

units.name: InitializeObjectYPlus16AndDisplay
units.summary: Shift Y by sixteen and set sprite-attribute bit $20.

units.name: InitializeObjectAuxiliaryDivider
units.summary: Clear the auxiliary timer and set its divider to two.

units.name: InitializeObjectDisplayFlag
units.summary: Set sprite-attribute bit $20 without moving the object.

units.name: InitializeOffsetAndSlotTimer
units.summary: Shift Y by sixteen and load the auxiliary timer using slot X; index zero reads the RTS byte at the table base.

units.name: InitializeObjectYMinus16AndDisplay
units.summary: Shift Y by minus sixteen and set sprite-attribute bit $20.

units.name: InitializeObjectYPlus32AndDisplay
units.summary: Shift Y by thirty-two and set sprite-attribute bit $20.

units.name: InitializeThirdSlotTimer
units.summary: Read the slot-indexed initial auxiliary timer from the RTS-based third table.

units.name: InitializeObjectYMinus8AndAreaFrame
units.summary: Shift Y upward by eight before selecting the per-area/per-slot frame.

units.name: InitializeObjectAreaFrame
units.summary: Index the PRG-pair-two frame table by eight times area plus object slot; switch to PRG pair six for frame setup and explicitly restore PRG pair two.

units.name: AdjustInitialObjectTerrainPlacement
units.summary: Skip terrain mode one; otherwise choose probe/movement offsets from area kind and placement type. Move only when the sampled cell is empty.

units.name: IncrementDecimalPairAndRefreshDisplay
units.summary: Increment the shared PRG-pair-zero decimal pair, restore the bank and request display update $10.

units.name: ReportDecimalPairAvailable

units.name: SceneDescriptorPointers_000314

units.name: PpuUploadDescriptorPointersAndRelatedBytes_00037E
units.summary: Little-endian descriptor pointers indexed by the PRG pair zero upload loader. The first cell is null. Twenty pointed seven-byte descriptors are supported; the last apparent pointer reaches executable palette code and is not a valid extra descriptor. Seven-byte records contain bank, two-byte output length, source pointer and optional two-byte PPU destination. The fixed upload loader reads these fields; adjacent records end at independently established palette code. This physical emission may be a slice of an overlapping consumer footprint; its boundary does not imply a separate original resource.

units.name: PaletteSourcePointersAndRelatedBytes_00052A

Null cells are retained without claiming they select a palette. The palette loader copies sixteen bytes from each selected source into the working palette. Some encoded values exceed $3F; this is the consumed representation, without a canonical six-bit color-domain claim.
