units.summary: Sixteen six-byte cache-offset records used by the bounded map-column reader. Indexed read footprints and independent next-table/routine boundaries establish the array; unrelated gap cells keep generic non-code status. Map-column rendering masks used to preserve/replace packed attribute bits. Finite indexed consumers and independent neighboring bases bound this data, without a global map-selector claim. Offset bytes used by the coarse-map/cache consumers. Their finite read footprints and adjacent independent bases support these bytes; the complete original encoding remains partly unresolved. Map attribute-row offset bytes used by finite indexed rendering reads. Neighboring bases and the following routine independently bound this non-code run. Map-rendering attribute policy values. Consumer reads and independently bounded neighbors establish non-code; unconsumed gap cells are not assigned an invented field meaning. Paired bit masks for replacing packed attribute quadrants. Bounded map-renderer indices establish the local representation, not an unrestricted selector domain. Repeated coarse-row selectors/offsets consumed by finite map and terrain indices. Independent adjacent table/routine origins fix the accepted span.

units.name: SpriteFramePointersAndRelatedBytes_01F9C4
units.summary: Paired frame-source pointers consumed by the object renderer after doubling frame index. Encoded neighboring resource/width origins or the following code bound the array. Frame and width counts can differ; no universal equality of their domains is claimed. Per-frame width bytes read through the selected width-table base. Independent next width origin, pointer origin or code boundary bounds the repeated small-value run. This is separate from the paired frame-pointer array's domain.

units.name: SpriteFrameWidthBytes_01FC37
units.summary: Per-frame width bytes read through the selected width-table base. Independent next width origin, pointer origin or code boundary bounds the repeated small-value run. This is separate from the paired frame-pointer array's domain. This physical emission may be a slice of an overlapping consumer footprint; its boundary does not imply a separate original resource.

units.name: SpriteFramePointers_01FC9A
units.summary: Paired frame-source pointers consumed by the object renderer after doubling frame index. Encoded neighboring resource/width origins or the following code bound the array. Frame and width counts can differ; no universal equality of their domains is claimed.

units.name: AlternateSpriteResourceFamilies_01FFC5
units.summary: Three family records provide split frame-pointer bases and paired PRG/CHR selectors to the alternate renderer. Families zero through two are supported locally; the following $FF run bounds the records without proving unrestricted Y validity.
roles: three split pointer base pairs and PRG/CHR selector pairs

units.name: ExtractAreaDisplayCoordinates
units.summary: Use area selector bits 4..5 and the player position to prepare display values in $2F/$31/$33. The coordinate lookup uses the full Y selector; callers must supply the established finite area domain.

units.name: SubtractAreaCreditDigits
units.summary: Subtract A units and Y tens from the two unpacked credit digits at $04C8/$04C9. Borrow adds ten to the units; negative tens clamps both digits to zero.

units.name: AdjustSecondaryDecimalCounters
units.summary: Subtract A from the two digits at $04CA/$04CB with decimal borrow and clamp at zero. Separate entries below add to or subtract from $04E7/$04E8; addition saturates at 99.

units.name: DecrementCounterIfNonzero
units.summary: Decrement $04E5 when nonzero; the zero case returns through the preceding RTS.

units.name: FinishSceneCommandDelay
units.summary: For command class three, advance the 16-bit accumulator and paired scratch coordinates before updating the scene record. Then perform a bounded CPU delay and frame synchronization.

units.name: BuildSceneFromPackedRecords
units.summary: Clear scene scratch, object state and 768 nametable bytes, initialize attributes, and consume successive packed scene sections. Install resource-derived fields and emit the final 48-byte attribute buffer. Helpers below parse phase records and dispatch only the supported phase selectors 0..4; the sixth phase boundary does not establish a sixth dispatch target.

units.name: EmitSceneGridRuns
units.summary: Draw phase-specific horizontal or vertical runs while updating the RAM grid. Flags in $43 select RAM writes and PPU writes separately. Length X is inclusive, so each path emits X+1 cells; valid coordinates and RAM pointers are entry preconditions.

units.name: ConsumeScenePlacementSections
units.summary: Consume sentinel-terminated placement sections into the nametable and RAM grid. Each helper supplies its own record width and tile/class rules. Rectangle and attribute helpers preserve their local counts in scratch; $FF ends each section.

units.name: DecodeScenePlacementCoordinates
units.summary: Convert packed coordinate bytes into nametable address $3B/$3C and grid row/column $13/$14, then resolve the RAM grid pointer. The second entry handles the single-byte coordinate representation.

units.name: DrawSceneBorderMask
units.summary: The leading RTS is a separate no-op hook. The following routine reads the area's four border flags, temporarily enables vertical PPU increments for side borders, restores horizontal increments, and fills selected edges with tile $B8.

units.name: LoadAreaPalettePairs
units.summary: Select background and sprite palette records through area-dependent selectors, copy 16 bytes of each into target buffers, and initialize low-nibble working palettes. Background color zero is shared; enable subsequent palette fade work.

units.name: DelayWithOptionalSceneFlag
units.summary: Save A, optionally set bit 7 of $045C, delay and synchronize a frame, then reload A for the existing continuation. This is a continuation rather than a standalone return contract.

units.name: MarkSceneObjectChange
units.summary: Increment the scene object's change counter and return one.

units.name: DrawSceneTwoByTwoTile
units.summary: Resolve a five-byte tile descriptor, write its four tiles as two nametable rows and apply its fifth byte to the attribute buffer. Return that attribute byte in A.

units.name: DrawCenteredAreaText
units.summary: Choose the area's text pointer, scan through the first byte with bit 7 set, and center the resulting finite string in a 28-cell span. Strip bit 7 on output and translate space to blank tile zero.

units.name: RunAreaPresentation
units.summary: Skip this presentation when $03EE is nonzero. Otherwise initialize display and motion state, play the area presentation, and run a synchronized two-object animation loop until input or a callback sets $0214. A periodic helper cycles six palette values.

units.name: UpdatePresentationSpritesAndMotion
units.summary: Build presentation sprite records from area-specific descriptors and update two motion tracks. Positive track timers consume duration/delta triples; negative timers invoke an encoded callback through $39/$3A. Callback targets below hide a sprite, change display/audio state or request exit.

units.name: InitializePresentationDisplay
units.summary: Clear 768 nametable bytes, hide sprite entries, and expose a separate palette interpolation helper. The final entry selects three area-dependent palette colors using a four-byte record stride.

units.name: DrawPositionedTextList
units.summary: Walk records containing a two-byte PPU destination followed by bit-7-terminated text. Destination high zero ends the list. Advance by the exact consumed string length before reading the next record.

units.name: HandleMenuSelection
units.summary: Read menu input, choose one of the four supported callback entries, then wait for selection buttons to release and finish the menu raster transition. Enabled-option scanning is handled separately.

units.name: InvokeMenuCallback
units.summary: Invoke the selected callback through $43/$44. The established local domain is four entries; this trampoline supplies no broader selector bound.

units.name: MenuActionHelpers
units.summary: Menu callbacks update the next-state byte, set an auxiliary request or wait for a fresh press. Sound cues accompany the actions. The press-wait callback uses $A0 as its accepted button mask.

units.name: FinishMenuRasterTransition
units.summary: Synchronize frames while reducing the raster offset by four; clamp it to $80 once subtraction crosses below that threshold.

units.name: MoveMenuSelection
units.summary: Detect fresh left/right input, wrap the selected index through three options and skip disabled cells. Increment the chosen option value after navigation; at least one enabled option is required to terminate scanning.

units.name: QueueAreaDisplayValues
units.summary: Queue fixed display tiles, extract area/position-derived values through the bank-preserving helper, then queue their numeric display at two PPU destinations and commit the upload.

units.name: HandleDebugAreaControls
units.summary: Detect controller-two direction edges and adjust the debug area selector within 0..46 using steps one or ten. Select commits the area; A requests another state. Additional entries queue numeric display packets and translate nibbles through a 16-cell glyph table.

units.name: DispatchDebugDisplayDescriptors
units.summary: Iterate eight-byte descriptors, load the selected RAM value and formatting arguments, and invoke the handler through $3B/$3C. A zero handler word ends the list. Handlers return by jumping to the common descriptor-advance continuation, rather than by RTS.

units.name: InstallAreaTimerValue
units.summary: Select an area-dependent timer value, with an alternate index for the $03EE path, and initialize the companion field to $3C.

units.name: ApplyCollectedItemState
units.summary: Dispatch the collected class in $44 into counter increments, decimal additions or a pending state value at $051B. Unmatched classes leave state unchanged.

units.name: ApplyCollectedCounterReward
units.summary: Play the collection cue and select a counter helper for classes $1C/$1D; other classes add one through the default helper and increment $051D.

units.name: EnterScriptedMotionCountdown
units.summary: Tail-enter the script-driven countdown motion body in the same physical PRG view.

units.name: EnterScriptedMotionSteering
units.summary: Tail-enter the script-driven steering body in the same physical PRG view.

units.name: SelectCountdownMotionFrame
units.summary: Decrement the motion countdown, divide by four and select a frame from the bounded countdown table before the shared coordinate/output helper.

units.name: UpdateScriptedMotionSteering
units.summary: Choose synthetic controller direction from position relative to a target, or follow the countdown animation path. The latter emits a cue at count $1F and alternates frame offsets before shared output.

units.name: PrepareScriptedMotionCoordinates
units.summary: Save the selected frame in A while converting the two grid coordinates to doubled screen coordinates with offsets 14 and 6. Continue into the existing output body.

units.name: BeginSceneEffectScratch
units.summary: Save A on the CPU stack, install scratch tile $B8, and call the effect helper. The matching existing continuation owns the stack restoration.

units.name: SceneEffectPhaseDecision
units.summary: Use the low two bits to choose between the two already classified effect continuations; this fragment inherits their entry context.

units.name: LoopPpuMaskTimingPattern
units.summary: Store X/A in two state bytes, then repeatedly write the PPU mask with its upper three bits clear and set around fixed NOP delays. This standalone timing loop never returns; hardware timing intent beyond these writes remains uncertain.

units.name: PlayerActionNoop
units.summary: Return without changing state; this is a finite player-action dispatch target.

units.name: UpdatePlayerActionPresentation
units.summary: Select presentation value four or twenty from scratch state, update it if different, and continue the player action. The alternate path stores A as a state-change request.

units.name: RequestPlayerSequenceFour
units.summary: Request sequence four with priority zero through the existing sequence-selection helper.

units.name: RequestPlayerRecoverySequences
units.summary: Install sequence six and clear two player fields unless already active. A separate entry sets facing from controller direction and requests sequence seven.

units.name: TestPlayerOrObjectStateTwo
units.summary: The first entry compares the player state to two. The second scans object slots seven down through one and returns carry clear on a matching state, set when none is found.

units.name: FinishObjectPositionTransfer
units.summary: Finish copying a source object's horizontal high byte with incoming carry and place its vertical coordinate eight pixels above the source. X/Y and carry come from the preceding classified body.

units.name: UpdateFixedObjectSlotTwo
units.summary: Call the shared object updater for slot two and return.

units.name: SetPlayerTransitionRequests
units.summary: Separate small entries clear the pending transition, set player state bit 7, or request transition $80 while setting the state-change flag and clearing a display/audio selector.

units.name: TestObjectAndPlayerConditions
units.summary: Return carry according to the indexed object field and the selected object's state range. A separate entry returns carry clear only when the player state byte is nonzero.

units.name: TestPlayerCommandOne
units.summary: Return carry clear only when the player's current command field equals one; otherwise return carry set.

units.name: ClearPlayerAuxiliaryFlag
units.summary: Clear $02C1 and return.

units.name: TestObjectCommand87
units.summary: Return carry clear for current command $87; other values branch to the existing failure return.

units.name: MapCommandToObjectState
units.summary: Separate predicates accept commands $81..$86 and assign states 3,8,9,10,11,5 respectively. Success clears carry; mismatches use the shared carry-set return.

units.name: AdvanceFourPhaseObjectState
units.summary: Mask the phase to two bits and select the corresponding object field value. Phase zero advances the stored phase once after selection.

units.name: FaceObjectTowardPlayer
units.summary: Compare the indexed object's horizontal position against the player's using the incoming borrow contract, and copy or invert the facing bit as required. Carry clear reports an applied facing value; existing exits handle the other cases.

units.name: SnapObjectToTerrainProbe
units.summary: Probe terrain at a facing-dependent horizontal offset. For returned low-nibble classes one or two, clear the object's state field and snap vertical position to the eight-pixel band plus five; other classes return carry set.

units.name: RestartTimedObjectScript
units.summary: Decrement the object's six-tick timer. At zero reset it to six; otherwise install the fixed script pointer $AE90 through the existing cursor initializer.

units.name: LoadPresentationValue79
units.summary: Load A with $79 and fall through into the existing presentation body.

units.name: ClearPresentationScratch
units.summary: Clear $2F and continue into the existing presentation body.

units.name: AdvancePositionScratch
units.summary: Increment the position scratch byte and fall through into the existing calculation.

units.name: WaitFrameCountdownOrInput
units.summary: Store A as a frame countdown and spin until the asynchronous frame updater clears it. The second entry also exits after a controller press/release cycle, clears the countdown and returns one. These routines require the existing interrupt-driven updater.

units.name: QueueThreeDisplayOperations
units.summary: Queue values $F0 and $B4, run the intervening display update, then tail-queue ten through the common helper.

units.name: BeginBankedDisplayOperation
units.summary: Preserve A in Y and save the PRG register shadow on the CPU stack, select pair zero and call the display helper. The existing continuation restores the saved selector.

units.name: UploadDisplayPacketAndRestorePairTwo
units.summary: Install packet pointer $BABC, invoke the upload helper, then select physical PRG banks 4/5 through MMC1 pair selector two.

units.name: RunBeforeRenderMenuHook
units.summary: Run the six menu/display update helpers in order and decrement the non-$FF exit timer, requesting state change when it expires. A separate entry advances the area selector with wrap from $39 to $30 and sets a pending transition.

units.name: HandleMenuChoiceAndCost
units.summary: Wrap the three-choice cursor on directional input. Confirmation selects one of nine action/cost records, checks its availability and debit status, subtracts the decimal cost and installs a pending transition. A helper increases the area's four-unit counter without reaching $40.

units.name: AdvanceMenuTimedSequence
units.summary: Consume index/delay pairs while the sequence is active; $FE installs the completion state and exit delay, while $FF is idle. Preserve previous/current choice and area values for the next display update.

units.name: UpdateMenuAffordabilityAndBlink
units.summary: Compare unpacked decimal credit digits against the selected cost, record whether the action is affordable and cycle six palette values when unaffordable. Frame masks pace palette updates and cue generation.

units.name: UpdateMenuPaletteAndTimer
units.summary: Copy four record bytes into several palette positions, count down the display timer and clear its active flags at zero. A separate entry starts an eight-tick palette update at index X.

units.name: DrawMenuFourByteRows
units.summary: Use X/Y to select source and destination pointers, copy two four-byte rows with the shared transfer helper, advancing source by four and PPU destination by 32 between rows.

units.name: RefreshMenuStatusRows
units.summary: Every fourth frame while the display timer is active, redraw current, selected and prior choices plus a clamped credit-derived status row, then commit the upload.

units.name: CallPairTwoHelperThenSelectSix
units.summary: Preserve A across selecting pair two, call its $AE03 helper, and finish by selecting pair six. This wrapper intentionally leaves pair six selected.

units.name: InstallPlayerActionOrSpawnRequest
units.summary: Select pair six, initialize command parameters and call the action helper, recording success before restoring pair two. Separate spawn entries prepare distinct classes and coordinate inputs for the shared request path.

units.name: PrepareAdditionalSpawnRequests
units.summary: Prepare classes $7F/$81 for the shared request path. The latter offsets horizontal position by -12 or +12 according to facing before invoking the existing common body.

units.name: ApplyObjectContactResult
units.summary: Store the contact result and check class, object state and relative coordinates. Qualifying contacts mark bit 7 of $8B; other eligible contacts request the existing state change through $69.

units.name: SpawnContactEffectAndPreserveSlots
units.summary: Save both slot registers, derive a presentation field for a finite object type, and request effect class four with parameter one. Restore X/Y and copy the contact result to a successful new slot. Allocation failure retains the allocator's known stack limitation; this is no universal return guarantee.

units.name: ToggleContactDirectionBits
units.summary: XOR the object's direction field with three and continue the existing contact body.

units.name: ResolvePlayerObjectContact
units.summary: Scan occupied object slots for a finite contact class, test overlap and either apply a shared result to both slots and create an effect, or decrement a short contact timer. Empty player state restores the incoming slot registers directly.

units.name: BranchPlayerContactZero
units.summary: Branch to the existing zero-result contact continuation; the flags come from the preceding classified code.

units.name: PlacePlayerAboveContactObject
units.summary: Set the player vertical coordinate relative to the contacted object, install player state $80 and flag $02C2, clear the vertical field and restore the active object slot.

units.name: ExtractAreaDisplayValuesPreservingBank
units.summary: Save the current PRG selector, select pair zero, extract the area display values and tail-restore the saved selector. The selected helper preserves the wrapper's $3B save field.

units.name: AddCreditPreservingBank
units.summary: Select pair zero around the two-digit credit addition and restore the caller's PRG selector through the shared wrapper contract.

units.name: SubtractCreditPreservingBank
units.summary: Select pair zero around decimal credit subtraction and restore the caller's PRG selector through the shared wrapper contract.

units.name: AdjustSecondaryCountersPreservingBank
units.summary: Separate wrappers select pair zero around subtraction from $04CA/$04CB and addition/subtraction at $04E7/$04E8, then restore the saved selector.

units.name: DecrementCounterPreservingBank
units.summary: Select pair zero around the nonzero decrement helper and restore the caller's selector.

units.name: SubtractCounterAndContinue
units.summary: Subtract through the bank-preserving decimal wrapper and tail-enter the existing common continuation.

units.name: CallDisplayHelperWithBankRestore
units.summary: Run the save/select helper, call the banked $B2F4 body and tail-enter its paired restore helper. This structural twin retains its supported local bank/return contract without claiming a natural caller.

units.name: SetAuxiliaryStateRequest
units.summary: For a nonzero input, store A into $02C4 and the state-change request; zero branches to the existing exit.

units.name: AggregateHighBitObjectFlags
units.summary: Update the underlying object flags, OR four selected bytes and retain their high bit in $02C7. If set, copy $0345 to the player vertical coordinate; otherwise use the existing continuation.

units.name: AddSaturatingSecondaryDigits
units.summary: Add A to the two unpacked digits at $04E7/$04E8. Propagate the units carry and saturate overflow to 99.

units.name: SubtractSecondaryDigits
units.summary: Subtract A from $04E7/$04E8 using decimal borrow; clamp negative results to zero.

units.name: UploadSceneAttributeBuffer
units.summary: Wait for PPU vblank, select $23C0 and upload 48 attribute bytes from $0704.

units.name: ClearSceneAttributeBuffer
units.summary: Clear 49 buffer bytes, then initialize the first eight to $FF.

units.name: ConsumeScenePhaseRecords
units.summary: Load split area pointers and walk section endpoints. Each pair supplies packed placement and count/flags. $FF terminates; only phase indices 0..4 have supported dispatch entries.

units.name: DispatchScenePhase
units.summary: Select split callback bytes for the supported phase, compute coordinate/grid pointers, separate write flags and inclusive run length, then tail-dispatch.

units.name: DrawSceneVerticalDoubleRun
units.summary: Select a two-tile variant from the existing grid class and flags. Advance PPU address by 32 and grid row by one after each inclusive run step.

units.name: DrawSceneVerticalSingleRunA
units.summary: Choose tile/class from the grid and flags, emit one tile per row and advance the corresponding grid pointer.

units.name: DrawSceneVerticalSingleRunB
units.summary: Use the alternate tile/class pair with the same vertical traversal and flag contract.

units.name: DrawSceneIndexedHorizontalRun
units.summary: Choose a per-area indexed class and tile, record its ordinal, and emit an inclusive horizontal run into enabled PPU/grid outputs.

units.name: DrawSceneRepeatedClass
units.summary: A supplies the tile descriptor class. Consume single-coordinate records through $FF and draw that class at each position.

units.name: DrawSceneIndexedObjects
units.summary: Consume coordinates with area-selected object variants; store the chosen variant and sequential grid class for each placement.

units.name: DrawSceneVerticalRecords
units.summary: Consume packed coordinate/count pairs and draw two-by-two class-one records down the nametable, advancing the grid by two rows each step.

units.name: DrawSceneHorizontalRecords
units.summary: Consume coordinate/flags pairs, draw inclusive horizontal runs of tile $B8 and write class 14 into the RAM grid while updating attributes.

units.name: DrawSceneRectangles
units.summary: Extract width and height from the packed second byte, then fill inclusive rows and columns with tile $94/class one and corresponding attributes.

units.name: DrawSceneExplicitClassRecords
units.summary: Consume coordinate/class pairs until $FF and draw the specified two-by-two class.

units.name: MergeSceneAttributeQuadrant
units.summary: Derive attribute byte index and two-bit quadrant from the PPU address. Mask out that quadrant, shift A into place and merge it into the RAM attribute buffer; preserve X.

units.name: DecodeCompactSceneCoordinate
units.summary: Convert the single packed coordinate into PPU address and grid coordinates, then fall through to the existing grid-pointer resolver.

units.name: DrawAreaBorders
units.summary: Read four area edge flags and fill the selected horizontal/vertical nametable borders with tile $B8.

units.name: DrawCenteredTextAtDestination
units.summary: Scan a bit-7-terminated string at $55/$56 and center it relative to the supplied destination before writing its glyphs.

units.name: CyclePresentationPalette
units.summary: Every eighth frame, advance a six-cell palette cycle and reset its index at six.

units.name: DrawPresentationMarker
units.summary: Convert the packed coordinate in Y and draw the tile descriptor supplied in A.

units.name: BuildPresentationSprites
units.summary: Select the area's sprite descriptor through one of two split pointer columns, hide old entries and emit enabled sprite groups.

units.name: UpdatePresentationMotionTrack
units.summary: For track X, skip hidden/disabled state, consume timed duration/delta triples or call an encoded callback on a negative duration. Apply deltas between record boundaries.

units.name: InvokePresentationMotionCallback
units.summary: Save track X, call the callback encoded in the delta fields, restore X and resume its timer at one.

units.name: PresentationMotionTrampoline
units.summary: Call through the two-byte callback pointer in $39/$3A.

units.name: RevealPresentationSprite
units.summary: Reveal the auxiliary sprite and invoke its counter/audio display changes.

units.name: HidePresentationSprite
units.summary: Move the auxiliary sprite to hidden Y=$F0.

units.name: RequestPresentationExit
units.summary: Increment the presentation exit latch.

units.name: HidePresentationSpriteEntries
units.summary: Set every fourth sprite-buffer byte from offset four to $F0, hiding the entries while preserving their other fields.

units.name: PresentationNoopHook
units.summary: Return immediately; separate from the following palette interpolation helper.

units.name: StepPresentationPalette
units.summary: Every 64 frames, add $10 toward two target palette bytes until each working byte equals its target.

units.name: LoadPresentationPaletteColors
units.summary: Select a four-byte palette record with an alternate area offset, and copy its first three colors into working and target sprite palettes.

units.name: MenuRequestNextState
units.summary: Play cue $23 and increment the pending-state field.

units.name: MenuRequestAuxiliaryState
units.summary: Play cue $14 and increment $02CC.

units.name: MenuWaitForFreshButton
units.summary: Wait for release then a fresh button under mask $A0, synchronizing through the menu updater.

units.name: MenuPlayConfirmationCue
units.summary: Play cue eight and return.

units.name: QueueFourNumericGlyphs
units.summary: If the upload cursor is below $E1, append a four-glyph packet plus $FF sentinel; packet fields come from the documented scratch words.

units.name: QueueTwoNumericGlyphs
units.summary: Append the corresponding two-glyph packet when the upload cursor has room.

units.name: TranslateFirstNumericNibbles
units.summary: Translate low/high nibbles of $2F into glyph bytes through the finite 16-entry table, then continue with $41.

units.name: TranslateSecondNumericNibbles
units.summary: Translate low/high nibbles of $41 into the second glyph pair.

units.name: AdvanceDebugDisplayDescriptor
units.summary: Advance the descriptor ordinal and loop; callback handlers jump here with the dispatcher's stack unchanged.

units.name: QueueDebugFourDigitValue
units.summary: Translate both packed numeric bytes and queue the four-glyph value, then jump to descriptor advance.

units.name: QueueDebugTwoDigitValue
units.summary: Translate the second packed byte and queue two glyphs, then jump to descriptor advance.

units.name: QueueDebugSingleValue
units.summary: Queue one value using descriptor coordinates, then jump to descriptor advance.

units.name: RequestFacingPlayerSequenceSeven
units.summary: Use directional input to set the player facing bit, then request sequence seven with priority one.

units.name: FindObjectStateTwo
units.summary: Scan non-player slots seven through one for state two. Carry clear reports a match; carry set reports none.

units.name: MarkPlayerStateHighBit
units.summary: Store $80 in the player state field and return.

units.name: RequestPlayerHighTransition
units.summary: Install pending transition $80, set the request flag and invoke the selector-zero helper.

units.name: TestPlayerStateNonzero
units.summary: Return carry clear for a nonzero player state and carry set for zero.

units.name: AcceptCommand82AsStateEight
units.summary: Accept command $82, set state eight and return carry clear; otherwise use the common failure return.

units.name: AcceptCommand83AsStateNine
units.summary: Accept command $83 and install state nine.

units.name: AcceptCommand84AsStateTen
units.summary: Accept command $84 and install state ten.

units.name: AcceptCommand85AsStateEleven
units.summary: Accept command $85 and install state eleven.

units.name: AcceptCommand86AsStateFive
units.summary: Accept command $86 and install state five.

units.name: WaitCountdownOrControllerPress
units.summary: Wait for countdown expiry or a complete controller press/release; the input exit clears the countdown and returns one.

units.name: RequestNextAreaWithinBand
units.summary: Advance the area, wrap at $3A to $30 and install a bit-7 pending transition plus request flag.

units.name: IncrementThreeChoiceMenu
units.summary: Advance the menu choice modulo three and start its highlight update.

units.name: HandleConfirmedMenuChoice
units.summary: Require idle timers, interpret directional/confirmation input, and dispatch the finite three-by-three action/cost records.

units.name: RequestCurrentAreaTransition
units.summary: Install a bit-7 transition for the current area and set the request flag.

units.name: IncreaseAreaMenuCounter
units.summary: Increase the area's counter by four only when the result remains below $40.

units.name: FinishMenuTimedSequence
units.summary: Start exit delay $B4, retain the previous choice and area, commit the new choice and mark the sequence idle with $FF.

units.name: StartMenuPaletteUpdate
units.summary: Install palette record index X and set both timers to eight.

units.name: PrepareSpawnClass7E
units.summary: Prepare class $7E using the selected horizontal and vertical inputs.

units.name: PrepareSpawnClass80
units.summary: Prepare class $80 with the alternate vertical input; share the success-recording body.

units.name: SubmitSpawnRequestAndRecordSuccess
units.summary: Call the spawn helper and set the pending-success fields only when its return indicates success.

units.name: PrepareFacingOffsetSpawnClass81
units.summary: Offset the horizontal coordinate by -12 or +12 according to facing and submit class $81.

units.name: AddSecondaryCounterPreservingBank
units.summary: Select pair zero, add to the saturating secondary decimal digits, then restore the saved selector.

units.name: SubtractSecondaryCounterPreservingBank
units.summary: Select pair zero, subtract from the secondary decimal digits, then restore the saved selector.

units.name: Table48AreaDependentCoordinateValues_0000FA
units.summary: 48 area-dependent coordinate values. Finite fields and boundaries follow the saved consumer and neighboring-record review; this does not assert natural selector coverage.

units.name: TableFourPaletteEmphasisMasks_000526
units.summary: Four palette emphasis masks. Finite fields and boundaries follow the saved consumer and neighboring-record review; this does not assert natural selector coverage.

units.name: TableSixteenTileIndicesPlusAttribute_0008A9
units.summary: Sixteen tile indices plus attribute. Finite fields and boundaries follow the saved consumer and neighboring-record review; this does not assert natural selector coverage.

units.name: TableSixteenTileIndicesPlusAttribute_0008ED
units.summary: Sixteen tile indices plus attribute. Finite fields and boundaries follow the saved consumer and neighboring-record review; this does not assert natural selector coverage.

units.name: TableSixteenTileIndicesPlusAttribute_000997
units.summary: Sixteen tile indices plus attribute. Finite fields and boundaries follow the saved consumer and neighboring-record review; this does not assert natural selector coverage.

units.name: TableSixteenTileIndicesPlusAttribute_000A74
units.summary: Sixteen tile indices plus attribute. Finite fields and boundaries follow the saved consumer and neighboring-record review; this does not assert natural selector coverage.

units.name: TableSixteenTileIndicesPlusAttribute_000A96

units.name: SetSecondaryGridFlag
units.summary: Set a bit in the second grid flag array using the shared selector-to-mask helper. The selector is masked to 63, yielding byte index 0..7. Entry requires PRG banks [8,9,14,15] and an ordinary stack; the helper preserves PRG context.

units.name: RestoreDiagonalEffectCoordinate
units.summary: Recover the coordinate saved before the sprite-output call, then compare it with the existing threshold. The output helper restores its own saved PRG bank before returning; this PLA balances the outer PHA. Requires valid sprite resources, bounded OAM output and aligned MMC1 writes in pair 4.

units.name: ActivatePendingScriptPriority
units.summary: After loading the script pointer, promote pending priority to active priority and clear the script timer. The pointer-loader leaf preserves X and PRG banks [12,13,14,15]; X must identify an object slot 0..7 with a valid script resource.

units.name: ReportDecimalDecrementResult
units.summary: A nonzero decimal decrement result sets the player action latch and returns. Zero continues into action selection. The decimal wrapper restores pair 6; valid decimal digits, an ordinary stack and no nested overwrite of its bank-save byte are required.

units.name: RememberAllocatedSpawnRecord
units.summary: Return immediately after saving the record offset for the allocated object. A zero allocator result returns through the existing failure exit. Both allocator outcomes restore Y and the stack; requires pair 6 and a valid staged spawn record.

units.name: AllocateStagedSpawnAndPosition
units.summary: Choose one of two staged packed records by frame parity and allocate an object. Restore the saved record index on both outcomes; failure returns zero through the existing exit. On success, expand the packed nine-bit coordinate by eight, store object X and return one. Requires pair 6, valid staged records/resources and a normal stack. Initialization writes CHR and RAM but preserves PRG context.

units.name: ClearAreaRasterSelector
units.summary: Finish the area upload by clearing the upper CHR raster selector. The descriptor uploader restores pair 6 on both raw and packed exits. Requires finite valid descriptors, rendering disabled, aligned MMC1 writes and an ordinary stack.

units.name: ChooseSecondaryAreaUpload
units.summary: Select descriptor $16 and enter the shared Y=1 upload. The nonzero selector makes this branch unconditional. After that upload, the shared path selects $18 for nametable initialization. The preceding uploader restores pair 6; valid finite descriptors and aligned MMC1 writes are required.

units.name: RequestCurrentAreaReload
units.summary: Request the current area again by setting the pending selector high bit and transition latch. This complete fixed-bank leaf preserves lower PRG banks; it requires only the current RAM selector and a normal stack.

units.name: RestoreAudioRequestScanIndex
units.summary: Restore the object scan index saved before the audio-priority request. The bounded fixed-bank audio leaf touches RAM and preserves the saved index byte; continue the existing descending scan.

units.name: SpawnThenRetreatColumnCursor
units.summary: Process the current spawn column before retreating the record cursor. The fixed-bank spawn helper may select pair 1 to read records but restores pair 6 on every supported normal return. Requires a valid spawn-list cursor and staged resources, an ordinary stack and aligned MMC1 writes.

units.name: GenericPatternData_76099
units.summary: This $28 byte continues the surrounding zero and small-value payload pattern. Neighboring regions and control references were inspected; the original format and consumer remain unknown. Preserve it as generic data without inventing a record schema.

units.name: EffectCommandParameterList
units.summary: Twelve command/parameter pairs followed by a zero command. The fixed-bank consumer advances its cursor by two and reads this list in pair 4; the first terminator and following code bound all 25 bytes. This local format does not establish a global selector domain or natural callback traversal.

units.name: GenericPatternData_110629
units.summary: A frame/duration-sized pair ($14,$08) repeats the neighboring command/payload pattern. Its non-code role is supported independently of natural script selection; the original stream extent remains unresolved. Generic data in physical PRG bank 13.

units.name: GenericPatternData_111850
units.summary: The fourth of four matching ten-byte script-shaped records: frame/duration, commands and a self-targeting transfer. Its final pointer matches the adjacent pointer sequence. These patterns establish non-code without proving a complete selector domain or original script layout; retain generic data.

units.name: GenericPatternData_113678
units.summary: The final $B4DA pointer-shaped pair matches the fourth repeated ten-byte record. The following $BC00 code entry independently bounds it. Retain generic data: correspondence does not prove the original array extent or natural selection of this cell.

units.name: AreaInitializationBytes
units.summary: Nine initialization bytes copied to RAM $04D5..$04DD by the fixed-bank descending Y=8..0 loop. The following NMI entry independently bounds the source. Lower PRG banks do not affect this physical bank-14 table.

units.name: GenericScriptPrefix105403
units.summary: The two-byte $80,$FF prefix continues the neighboring script-shaped non-code pattern. Command widths, RAM-only frame/yield handlers, thirteen matching accepted prefixes and the independently bounded 29-byte representation support generic data. The original stream start, schema and natural selection remain unresolved.
